newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
SOUTH KOREA, Feb 10 - Busan - 203 vessels in port, 70 at berth, 133 at anchorage. Usually three to four days delay due to berth congestion.
Ulsan - 60 Vessels in port 40 at berth, 20 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due to berth congestion.
Pohang - 41 Vessels in port, 38 at berth, three at anchorage, no delay.
Inchon - 71 Vessels in port, 53 at berth, 18 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due to berth congestion.
